name: Sasol Limited
sector: Energy & Chemicals — Integrated fuels and chemicals (South Africa)
moat_justification: Weak moat: Sasol owns genuinely hard-to-replicate assets — the proprietary Fischer-Tropsch process, the integrated Secunda coal-to-liquids complex, its own coal mining feedstock and low-cost Mozambique gas — but it is a commodity price taker in fuels and chemicals with no pricing power, and the returns record proves it: the roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json runs 7.3% (FY2021), 18.1% (FY2022), 5.1% (FY2023), -9.8% (FY2024) and 5.4% (FY2025) — below a plausible cost of capital in most years and violently cyclical. Recurring impairments (R76.0B in FY2024, R21.8B in FY2025, R16.8B in FY2026 per the company's annual financial statements) show the asset base repeatedly fails to earn its carrying value, and Secunda carries structural carbon/regulatory exposure. A 3 gives CAP 5.9 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 16 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency ZAR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Sasol Limited's own results documents (e.g. Reviewed interim financial results, Sasol Limited, filed with its 20-F reporting package): 'American depository receipts (ADR) program: CUSIP number 803866300 — ADR to ordinary share 1:1; Depositary: The Bank of New York Mellon' — the ratio stated by the filer itself in every results booklet and in the Form 20-F share-capital description) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Sasol Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2026 (published 1 September 2026; the same table appears in the FY2025 statements), Earnings per share note, 'Number of shares' table: weighted average number of shares 633.0M for FY2024, plus potential dilutive effect of the convertible bond 39.9M and of the long-term incentive scheme 7.0M, giving 'Diluted weighted average number of shares for DEPS and DHEPS' 679.9M for FY2024 (642.0M for FY2025 and 648.5M for FY2026 in the same table — the FY2025 figure matches the engine's filed AdjustedWeightedAverageShares count exactly, confirming the basis)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 1.05 vs 3-yr median 0.28 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.8% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 19.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Commodity fuels-and-chemicals price taker, moat 3/10 — at $15.69 the normalized base OE is $0.28/share (a 1.8% OE yield, net debt 19.3x normalized OE), so the weighted IRR is 4.16% with IV@15% $2.11; even on the latest-FY base ($1.05/share) a sensitivity run prints only 8.71% / $7.84 — it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$2.11 on the normalized base.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Proprietary Fischer-Tropsch technology and the integrated Secunda complex — a coal/gas-to-liquids asset that cannot be replicated at economic cost today
Own coal mining feedstock and low-cost Mozambique natural gas give an integrated cost position in Southern African fuels
Scale and incumbency in South African liquid fuels (Secunda + Natref share) and a diversified chemicals portfolio across Africa, America and Eurasia
Balance sheet repairing: net debt fell to US$3.3B at FY2026 (company results) from US$3.7B at FY2025, capex discipline holding cash fixed costs flat for three years
moat_against: Pure commodity price taker — Brent, refining margins and chemical basket prices set earnings; no pricing power
ROIC history is weak and volatile: roic_proxy -9.8% in FY2024, 5.1-5.4% in FY2023/FY2025, spiking only to 18.1% in the FY2022 price shock (fundamentals.json)
Recurring mega-impairments: R76.0B (FY2024), R21.8B (FY2025), R16.8B (FY2026) — Secunda/Sasolburg refinery CGUs remain fully impaired
Carbon and regulatory exposure: Secunda is one of the world's largest single-point CO2 emitters; South African carbon tax and emissions rules raise its cost curve over time
Feedstock decline: Mozambique gas fields (Pande/Temane) in natural decline, FY2026 gas production -7%; South African chemicals swung to an EBIT loss in FY2026
Dividend suspended until net debt is sustainably below US$3B (policy threshold not met at FY2025 or FY2026) — equity holders wait behind the balance sheet
